text: Shadeskin Brandy Phials are pick pocketed from humanoids in Revendreth. It can also be looted from Forgotten Chests.
__NOTOC__ Shadeweaver Zeris is a rare elite maw caster located in Perdition Hold in the Maw.
Shadehound Spirithunters are shadehounds located in the Beastwarrens in the Maw.

__NOTOC__ Sha'zul is a jungle troll ghost located at the Darkmaul Plains on Exile's Reach. As his last act before crossing over to the Other Side, he teaches a fellow priest how to cast Resurrection to save some orcish recruits.
__NOTOC__ Mawsworn Gatekeepers are soul eaters located at the Seeker's Quorum in Korthia.
Shaded Stone Statues are created with Shadowlands Jewelcrafting (100); taught by Design: Shaded Stone Statue.
Shade Eyes drop from Nascent Shades for Weapons of the Tremaculum during the Venthyr Assault in the Tremaculum on the Maw.

Shaded Bag of Ore is created by Transmute: Stones to Ore from Shadowlands alchemists at 160 skill. The recipe is taught by Archivist Roh-Suir at Keeper's Respite in Korthia to players at standing with the Archivists' Codex. Like all transmutes, alchemists can only complete one transmute a day. The reagents are: *4x Porous Stone *2x Shaded Stone
Shadehunter's Crescent drops from Riftbound Caches in Korthia.
Shaded Skull Shoulderguards drop from the following chests in Korthia and the Maw: *Rift Hidden Cache *Riftbound Cache *Zovaal's Vault

Shaded Judgment Stone occasionally drops from a number of mobs, such as the Screaming Shade in Korthia. Access The Rift of Korthia, interact with the shade, bring it back to the normal plane of reality, then defeat it.
Shadehound Tack drops from the following chests in Korthia and the Maw: *Helsworn Chest *Mawsworn Cache *Spectral Bound Chest
Shackles of Fate is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating all bosses in the upper tiers of the Sanctum of Domination.
Shadeweaver's Spire drops from Shadeweaver Zeris at Perdition Hold in the Maw.
Shadewarped Sash is dropped by Artificer Xy'mox in Castle Nathria.
Shackles of Alluring Vitality drop from Kryxis the Voracious in Sanguine Depths.
Shademaster Kiryn's Report is obtained by talking to Shademaster Kiryn in Grookin Hill in the Jade Forest for Gauging Our Progress.

Shadeberry Shandy is sold by the following vendors for : *Tremen Winefang in Revendreth *Fencer in Revendreth *Teffle in Revendreth *Tavian in Sinfall *Ima in Revendreth *Kegs in The Ember Court *Night Guardian Vekraala in Sinfall
Shadar Spirit Beads are a quest reward from The Purge of Veil Shadar.
Shadar Choker is a quest reward from The Purge of Veil Shadar.
Sezz'ziz's Captive Kickers drop from Nekrum Gutchewer and Shadowpriest Sezz'ziz in Zul'Farrak.
Sewing Gloves are a quest reward from The Chill of Death (Classic).
Shackles of the Bound Guardian drop from Euv'ouk in Provis Strata in Zereth Mortis.
Shado-Pan Crossbow Bolt Bundle is provided as an objective for In Skilled Hands.
Shado-Pan Fire Arrows are found at Dusklight Hollow in Townlong Steppes.
Shackled Servitors are vrykul located on the Naglfar in the Maw of Souls.

The Shade of Irik-tu is a soul in the form of a tarachnid invisibly spying on Firim in Exile's Hollow in Zereth Mortis. Players can only see them while dead after completing A New Architect. Speaking with them gives the player Schematic: Ineffable Skitterer, after which they disappear.
Shado-Pan Novices are pandaren encountered before Master Snowdrift's encounter in the Shado-Pan Monastery.
Shado-Pan Ice Archers are pandaren encountered in the Shado-Pan Monastery between the Cloudstrike and Swiftstrike Dojos. They rain ice arrows down upon players moving through the area.
Shado-Pan Fire Archers are pandaren encountered in the Shado-Pan Monastery between the Swiftstrike Dojo and the Sealed Chambers. They rain fire arrows down upon players moving through the area.
Shadehide Foragers are bears located at Tyrhold Reservoir in Thaldraszus.
Sha Shooters are sha located at Thunder Hold in the Jade Forest.
Shackles of Titanic Failure drop from Raszageth in the Vault of the Incarnates.

__NOTOC__ The Shade of Grief is a ghostly rare green dragon that spawns upon interacting with Solethus's Gravestone, which is occasionally available inside a cave in the northern cliffs of the Emerald Gardens in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
The Shadepaw pack of gnolls is native to the Azure Span. They are at war with the Iskaara Tuskarr.
Shades of Hate are shades located at Lake Mennar in Azshara during Survey the Lakeshore.
Sha-Touched Guardians are pandaren found in the Terrace of the Twin Dragons in the Temple of the Jade Serpent.
Sha-Haunted Crystal is found at the Clutches of Shek'zeer in the Dread Wastes.
Sha Attunement Device is provided as an objective for Lingering Doubt (quest).
Sha-Seared Sandals drop from the Fallen Protectors in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
Shadehide Maulers are bears located at Tyrhold Reservoir in Thaldraszus.
Shackles of the Shadowed Bastille drops from Rashok, the Elder in Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible.
Shade's Blade is created with Classic Blacksmithing (300); taught by Ancient Plans: Shade's Blade.
Severs drops from the following bosses in Torghast, Tower of the Damned: *Synod *Patrician Cromwell *Goxul the Devourer
Shadespinner's Web drops from Rustfang Creeper and Spider Eggs in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
Severely Rusted Lockbox is sold by Mrrl in Nazjatar for . Cleaning the lockbox yields a Barnacled Lockbox.
Shademire Seal is created through the use of a Baleful Ring.
Shackles of the Dreaded Flame drops from the world boss Bazual in the Azure Span.

Shadow Bolt is a level 1 warlock spell that deals direct damage to the target. It's the primary filler spell for both Affliction and Demonology warlocks. For Destruction warlocks it is replaced by Incinerate. For Demonology warlocks, Shadow Bolt generates a Soul Shard each time it is cast.

The Shadow Council is a group of mortal warlocks that serve the demons of the Burning Legion. The Shadow Council was formed by orcs as a clandestine council of the Old Horde. In the aftermath of many wars, the Shadow Council has somehow continued and has expanded to include many races with cults of the Shadow Council existing in different parts of the world.
__NOTOC__ Shadow Oil gives the user a 15% chance to cast Shadowbolt III at the attacker on each hit.

__NOTOC__ Shadow Hold, located in western Felwood, is a former night elf barrow den which now serves as the Shadow Council's stronghold on Azeroth. It is a gigantic subterranean labyrinth roamed by Jaedenar warlocks and their demonic pets. The satyr Prince Xavalis and dreadlord Lord Banehollow also reside here. The night elf Arko'narin was formerly held captive inside as well as her close friend, a human and paladin of the Silver Hand named Trey Lightforge, who later turned out to have been tortured to death. Arko'narin escaped and returned to Darnassus, eventually becoming a warden.
Shadow Mastery is an Affliction warlock specialization bonus that increases shadow spell damage by 30%.

__NOTOC__ Shadow Hunter Vosh'gajin is an elite forest troll shadow hunter mini-boss located in Tazz'Alor in Lower Blackrock Spire. She is a former lover of Kilram, a troll blacksmith in Everlook. She gave him a scar on his face, calling it a "love tap".
Shadow Goggles are cloth headwear that can only be used by engineers.
__NOTOC__ Shadow Protection Potion will protect the imbiber from all shadow related damage.
Shadow Protection is a Priest buff that increases a friendly target's Shadow resistance. If the target is in your party or raid, all party and raid members will be affected.
Shadow Mantle of the Dawn is a special enchantment for shoulder armor that adds shadow resistance.
__NOTOC__ Shadow Silk is dark smoky-colored silk spun by spiders. It is often used in Tailoring patterns.

__NOTOC__ Shadow Priestess Vandis is a Forsaken quest giver located at the Bulwark in the Forsaken starting zone of Tirisfal Glades. She is High Executor Derrington's second-in-command, and has been put in charge of countering the Scourge cauldrons that have been placed in the Plaguelands.
Shadowblade is a one-handed dagger with a shadow bolt damage proc.
Shadow Guard is attached to head and leg armor to enchant the item with shadow resistance.
__NOTOC__ Shadow Priest Sarvis is a Forsaken quest giver located in Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.
__NOTOC__ Shadow Priest Allister is a Forsaken located at the Sepulcher of Silverpine Forest. He wrote a book, Holy Bologna: What the Light Won't Tell You, that eventually reached Dire Maul.
Shadow Sprites are grells located in Teldrassil, just to the northwest of Dolanaar.
__NOTOC__ Shadow Draenite is mined from Fel Iron, Adamantite and Rich Adamantite deposits. It is also a World Drop.

The Shadow Labyrinth is one of four instances in Auchindoun. It is occupied almost entirely by orcs and demons from the Burning Legion, such as felguards and shivarras. The instance comes to an end with a confrontation against the essence of sound, Murmur. The entry is granted from the south end of Auchindoun. The minimum required level to enter is 65.

.]] Shadow Weaving is a priest talent which buffs the priest, increasing all shadow damage done by the priest by 2% per stack. Each point increases the chance to apply the buff by 33%, for a maximum of 100% chance.
Shadow Panthers are panthers found in the Swamp of Sorrows. Apothecary Faustin requires their hearts.

Shadow Ridge is a series of high, craggy hills located in southwestern Ammen Vale. They are currently inhabited by many blood elves, who are responsible for tampering with the Exodar and forcing it to crash. They have followed the draenei from the Outland, and are aligned with Kael'thas Sunstrider .
Shadow Chargers are level 18-85 elite skeletal horses that can be found in Shadowfang Keep.
__NOTOC__ Shadow Labyrinth Key opens the doorway to the instance Shadow Labyrinth.
Shadow's Embrace is a cloth epic crafted set from the Burning Crusade. It is crafted by Tailoring. And was intended for Frost Mages, Warlocks and Shadow Priests.
The Shadow Stair is the looming set of steps carved into the northern part of Auchindoun's Ring of Observance. It is densely populated by cultists of the Shadow Council.

Shadow Tomb is a crypt located northwest of Auchindoun at in the Bone Wastes. It is occupied by cultists of the Shadow Council known as the Cabal, led by a Shivarra named Hathyss the Wicked. Her admonishments can often be heard echoing through the halls. Akuno has been kidnapped and is under guard within the tomb.
Shadow Focus increases your chance to hit enemies with your Shadow spells and reduces their mana cost.
Shadow Reach is a shadow talent that increases the range of all shadow spells. This allows the shadow priest are more far distance before the enemy reaches them.
Shadow Resilience was a Shadow Priest talent that effectively gave resilience, but only against spells--making its usefulness limited.
Shadow Weaver Leggings drop from Nightbane Shadow Weavers at the Rotting Orchard in Duskwood. During , they were available via Crate of Salvage and Big Crate of Salvage.
__NOTOC__ Shadow Pillagers are orcs and Forsaken found in Karazhan with their homunculi minions. Within Return to Karazhan few can be spotted upside down at Guardian's Library.
Shadow Panther Hide Gloves drop from trash mobs in Zul'Gurub.
Shadow Panther Hide Belt drops from trash mobs in Zul'Gurub.
Shadowbeast are darkhounds found in the Servants' Quarters of Karazhan.
Shado 'Fitz' Farstrider is a tauren quest giver located at the Nesingwary Safari in Nagrand.
Shadow-walker's Cord drops from Shade of Akama in the Black Temple.
__NOTOC__ Shadow Dust is turned in to Severin at Blackwind Landing for an Elixir of Shadows. 6 dust is required for each elixir.

__NOTOC__ Shadow Pearl is a rare pearl found inside the Jaggal Clams, dropped by the naga of Zangarmarsh, and has a chance to be found in Bag of Fishing Treasures. It is an ingredient in jewelcrafting recipes.
Shadow Council Gloves can be looted from most level 63-73 demon, and humanoid monsters.
World of Warcraft: Shadow Wing is a Burning Crusade manga duology. *Written by Richard A. Knaak. *Art by Kim Jae-Hwan.
The Shadow Council Chain is a world drop from mobs in zones.
Shadow Horrors are weak shades that periodically appear while cursed with [http://www.wowhead.com/?spell=36844 Curse of Horrors] from Daughter of Destiny in Netherstorm.
Shadow Council Cowl is a random drop in most Outland zones. Its name refers to the Shadow Council - a puppet organization of the Burning Legion.
:"Diversify." —Harnessing Shadows by Lady Sevine Shadow and Flame is a warlock talent on tier 8 of the Destruction tree. It boosts the damage of the warlock's Shadow Bolt and Incinerate spells.
Shadow Panther Hearts drops from Shadow Panthers in the Swamp of Sorrows.

Shadows of Doom can be found in Azshara, Blasted Lands, Burning Steppes, Eastrn Plaguelands, Tanaris and Winterspring during the Scourge Invasion. They spawn after disrupting the ritual of one of the four Cultist Engineers surrounding Necrotic Shards with eight Necrotic Rune.
Shadow Hunter Knife is dropped by Witherbark Shadow Hunters in the Arathi Highlands.
Shadow Lord Fel'dan's Head drops from Shadow Lord Fel'dan in Felwood.
Shadow Demons are observers that spawn during phase 4 of the fight against Illidan Stormrage at the Temple Summit in the Black Temple.

The Shadow Vault is located deep within Scholomance. It is accessed from the Headmaster's Study via the northern doorway on the lower level. This is where the ghostly Lady Illucia Barov can be found, amid a few skeletal mages.
Shadow Lord Xiraxis is the final encounter of Someone Else's Hard Work Pays Off. His fight is similar to Nexus-Prince Shaffar without his Sparks.
This is a page listing loot to be found in Shadow Labyrinth. For information about the instance itself, see Shadow Labyrinth.   __TOC__
{{tooltip-wc3 |mode={} |arg={} |name=Shadow Orb Fragment |icon= |desc= }} A fragment of the Shadow Orb.
Shadow of Death was a death knight talent located on tier 4 of the Unholy tree.
Shadow Constructs are skeletal mages summoned by Lady Alistra from the Realm of Shadows for her Disciples.
Shadow Crystals can be mined from: * Titanium Vein * Cobalt Deposit * Saronite Deposit * Rich Saronite Deposit Prospected from: * Cobalt Ore * Saronite Ore
Shadows Revenants are a type of Death Revenant held together by a strange elemental force. They are found in Wintergrasp.
Shadow wolves are a spirit wolves that can be summoned by far seers to do their bidding.
Shadows of Aran appears in each of the alcoves around the edge of the room and assist the Shade of Aran in battle.
Permanently enchant a cloak to increase Agility by 6 and armor by 6.
Shadow Hunter Mezil-kree is a jungle troll quest giver located at the Sunreaver Pavilion in the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown. He was present during Death Rising.
Skeletal Vault Gryphons are level 80 skeletal gryphons found in the Shadow Vault in Icecrown.
Shadow is the timber wolf pet of Dorion, located in Darnassus. During the Burning of Teldrassil, it was caught in the chaos and could be saved.
Shadow Channelers are located at Aldur'thar: The Desolation Gate in Icecrown. They are channeling shadow...
Inflicts 110 Shadow damage to an enemy target and nearby allies, affecting up to 3 targets.

The Shadow Throne is the private chamber of the Lich King inside the Halls of Reflection. It is a dark and twisted mockery of the imperial chamber of Lordaeron, and is reached by a long hall from Sword's Rest. A hidden passage lies nearby, leading to a platform outside.
Shadowblade's Battlegear is the lower-level tier 10 rogue set.
Shadow-Cleanser Bracers is a quest reward from Children of Tortolla.
The Shadow Realm (or the realm of shadow(s)) is a plane of existence on Draenor/Outland visited by the arakkoa. It is related to the Void.

The Shadow Wing Lair is the second room of Blackwing Lair where players encounter Vaelastrasz the Corrupt losing a fight over control of his mind with Lord Victor Nefarius. To progress in the raid, Vaelastrasz must be defeated, as a gate blocks the way into the Halls of Strife until then. The Dragonmaw Garrison (where Razorgore the Untamed was encountered) is directly linked to the Shadow Wing Lair; there are no trash mobs in between.
__NOTOC__ Shadow Adepts are humans of the Cult of the Damned found grouped together performing some sort of ritual in the Broken Front of Icecrown.
The Shadow of Perfect Bliss drops from Asaad in Vortex Pinnacle.
__NOTOC__ Shadow-Walker Zuru is a revered jungle troll priest trainer located in the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar. He was present at the funeral ceremony of Vol'jin in the Dranosh'ar Blockade.

The Shadow Wardens are wardens led by Captain Saynna Stormrunner. They helped fight elementals at the Regrowth. After the escape of Fandral Staghelm, Malfurion Stormrage asked Stormrunner and her Barrow Deeps Watchers to help at the Molten Front in the Firelands to assist the Guardians of Hyjal in hunting the Druids of the Flame. They took the loss of Fandral from their custody very seriously, so it didn't take much prodding to bring the Shadow Wardens to the fight.
__NOTOC__ The Shadow Wardens are night elves found at the Forlorn Spire in Molten Front, after completing The Forlorn Spire (quest).
The Shadows of Obsidius are reflections of Ascendant Lord Obsidius that assist during the battle.
__NOTOC__ Shadow Spinel has a random chance to be found inside Crystalline Geode and Elementium-Coated Geode.
Shadow Lords spawn during the Cho'gall encounter in Bastion of Twilight.

The Shadow of Leotheras is a demon that has been consumed and controlled by Leotheras the Blind in the Serpentshrine Cavern. He seeks to taste true freedom, but is unable to leave the body of Leotheras. Leotheras is able to call forth this demon to aid him in battle however, and does so during his encounter. When Leotheras is greatly weakened (brought to 15% health), this demon is able to escape and experience his freedom, if only for a short time.

Shadow Council Enforcers are orcs found in the Black Morass coming through the newly created Dark Portal. They were sent by Gul'dan and his Shadow Council in order to prove the skeptic orcs back on Draenor that Azeroth was a lush world, ripe for the Horde to plunder. Before leaving, they caught and killed local reptile and feline beasts in order to prove they were edible.
Shadow Blades is a Subtlety rogue talent that significantly increases damage and combo point generation.
The Shadow of Doubt is a sha located in the Jade Temple Grounds in the Jade Forest.
Shado-Pan Trainees are pandaren found at the Setting Sun Garrison of the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Shadow-Walker Staff is a quest reward from A Seer's Staff (jungle troll).
Shado-Pan Wu Kao are pandaren located at Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.
__NOTOC__ Shadow Pigment is commonly obtained from milling herbs native to Pandaria. Milled from: * Desecrated Herb * Fool's Cap * Green Tea Leaf * Rain Poppy * Silkweed * Snow Lily
__NOTOC__ Shadow Priestess Malia is a Forsaken shadow priest located at Brill in Tirisfal Glades.

Shadow, Storm, and Stone is a lore object located at in the northwestern nook of the thunder forge room of the Thunder Forges on the Isle of Thunder. Interacting with the lore object is one of the requirements of the Pandaria exploration achievement Gods and Monsters.
__NOTOC__ Shado-Pan Wardens are pandaren that patrol the entrance of the Shado-Pan Monastery.
The Shadow of Thel'zan the Duskbringer is the shadowy projection of Thel'zan the Duskbringer in the Wintergarde Crypt in the Dragonblight.
Shadow Hopper is a quest achievement earned for bouncing a ball with a hatchling 25 times in a row without dropping it.
Shadow Reflection is a level 100 rogue talent, added in Warlords of Draenor.
Shadow Tomes can be found in Veil Shadar during the quest Forbidden Knowledge. As objects they have various names, listed here.

Shadow Hunter Rala is a jungle troll who entered Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge via Khadgar's portal with the first wave with Gazlowe and his builders and went to scout the nearby area with his sister Mala. Sent by Rokhan to establish a supply base, Rala is then seen in Darkspear's Edge in Frostfire Ridge. Being surrounded by big monsters and savage giants, he asked the Commander to gather doses of lurker venom and Frostbloom leaves in order to make poison and combat the savage beasts. From the gathered reagents he created a vial of poison to be used against Grosh the Mighty, who had a big stash of pillaged hides and leathers that the trolls wanted to gather for the troops at the garrison. Vol

Shadow Hunter Mala is a jungle troll who entered Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge via Khadgar's portal with the first wave with Gazlowe and his builders. She is then seen in Darkspear's Edge. During the Fourth War when Zalazane returned to the Echo Isles, Mala defended the ashes of Vol'jin near the Darkspear Training Grounds.
__NOTOC__ Shadow Disciples are orcs located in the Ruins of Ata'gar in Frostfire Ridge. They are accompanied by Felhound Minions.
__NOTOC__ Shadow Council Pyromancers are orcs found within the Burning Front of Talador. They have been tasked with invading .
Shadowborne Reverends are orcs located in Telmor in Talador.
__NOTOC__ Shadowborne Dementors are orcs located in Gul'rok in Talador.
__NOTOC__ Shadowbark is a Draenor ancient located in Undergrowth in Spires of Arak.

Shadow Hunter Gar'ant is a jungle troll found in the town hall in Warspear in Ashran. He was an Honor Quartermaster until 6.2. He was present at the funeral ceremony of Vol'jin in the Dranosh'ar Blockade.
Shadow Clone is a projection located north of the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands. It would appear when engaging Scoutmaster Hasark.
Shadow Hunter Askia is a jungle troll found in Warspear. She is located by the tauren quarter's central fire, where she is engaged in conversation with Rala Wildheart.
__NOTOC__ Shadow Hunter Zasta is a jungle troll that was sent to to spy on the Iron Horde. He was killed by Warlord Azuka. The commander went to find him only to find his corpse and to be imprisoned.

Shadow Hunter Moj'jar is a jungle troll of the Darkspear tribe found in the Frostwall garrison of Frostfire Ridge. He informed the Horde Commander of fellow Shadow Hunter Bwu'ja's dissapearance since she was sent to keep an eye on the Bloodmaul clan.
Shadow-Sage Brakoss is an arakkoa found in the Town Hall in Stormshield.
__NOTOC__ Shadow Hunter Zel'duk is a jungle troll located in eastern Tanaan Jungle.
Shadow Hunter Taz is a jungle troll found in Wor'var in . He argues with Stalker Ogka.
Shadow Hunter Mok'e is a jungle troll quest giver located in .
The Shadow Rise is the highest point in Gul'var. This is the location where the leaders of the meet.
Shadow Hunter Bwu'ja is a Darkspear troll located at the Stonefury Cliffs in Frostfire Ridge.
Shadow Word: Void is a level 15 Shadow priest talent that replaces Mind Blast.
Shadow Council Missives drop from members of the in Tanaan Jungle.

.]] The Shadow Web Caverns are an area in Azjol-Nerub. Arthas Menethil crossed this cave to reach the Old Kingdom and later Icecrown Glacier. He fought a group of dwarves led by Baelgun Flamebeard and some still-living nerubians led by Queen Nezar'Azret. The caverns have some hidden passages crafted by the nerubians during their time. It also houses a nerubian hoarding cell, which are chambers where they used to keep most of their treasures hidden. Presumably, the caverns are between the entrance of the nerubian home (which may or may not be The Gilded Gate) and the Old Kingdom Gate.
Shadow's Caress was a Subtlety rogue honor talent, available at rank 6.
Shadow Ritualist Phylacteries are containers in Spoils of Pandaria encounter in Siege of Orgrimmar.
Shadow Thrash is a Feral druid artifact trait. It is linked to the Honed Instincts and Feral Instinct (druid artifact trait) traits.
Shadow Nova is a Subtlety rogue artifact trait. It is linked to the Soul Shadows trait.
Shadow Fangs is a Subtlety rogue artifact trait. It is linked to the Goremaw's Bite (artifact trait), Gutripper (rogue artifact trait) and Fortune's Bite traits.
Shadow Swiftness is an Assassination rogue artifact trait. It is linked to the Balanced Blades (rogue artifact trait), Master Assassin (artifact trait) and Fade into Shadows traits.
Shadow Walker is an Assassination rogue artifact trait. It is linked to the Urge to Kill and Bag of Tricks traits.
Shadowblade's Murderous Omen is a quest reward from Hiding In Plain Sight.
Shadow Fracture is a Legion camp covered in Void energies where eredar are enslaving voidwalkers.
Shadow Thread can be extracted from Vandros' Shadoweave Robes.
Shadow's Whisper is a Subtlety rogue artifact trait. It is linked to the Weak Point and Feeding Frenzy (rogue artifact trait) traits.
Shadowblade Acolytes are wrathguard located in Invasion Points.
Shadow-Touched Krokuls are Broken located at the Ruins of Oronaar in Eredath.
Shadow Vault Abominations are abominations attacking The Shadow Vault in Icecrown.
Shadow Vault Skirmishers are Geists attacking The Shadow Vault in Icecrown.
Shadow Vault Assaulters are vrykul death knights attacking the Shadow Vault in Icecrown.
Shadow Sporebats are sporebat companions located in Zangarra in Talador.
Shadow of Gorak Tul was a Gorak Tul's projection located at the Crimson Forest in Drustvar.

Shadow Hunter Narez is a jungle troll from the Darkspear tribe. She is mainly located at Krag'wa's Shore in Nazmir. After completing all of her quests, she becomes accepted as a follower of Krag'wa the Huge, the frog loa. She is present in Zanchul in Dazar'alor during Talanji's coronation.
Shadow Fragments are crystals located in the Seat of the Triumvirate of Eredath.
Shadow-Pan Battle Tiger was a tiger located in the cut Defense of the Alehouse battleground. It may have been intended to be a Shado-Pan tiger.
Shadow-Soaked Stalker Heart is looted from Brittle Krokul Chest and Gleaming Footlocker and a reward from Ancestral Arms and Relics of Ascendancy.
Shadow Pounders are tentacles located in the Rift of Aln in The Emerald Nightmare.
Shadow serpent mounts are vanity mounts first introduced in World of Warcraft: Legion.
The Shadow of the Necropolis trailer is the official trailer for Patch 1.11: Shadow of the Necropolis.
Shadow Hunter's Bow is a quest reward from Hour of Reckoning (Horde).

The Shadow Tear is found in a eye socket of a green dragon's skull at the Emerald Dragonshrine of Dragonblight. It is part of the storyline for Uuna and provides access to a short scenario, A Dark Place.
Shadow Council Ritualists are orcs located in the Den of Secrets in .
Shadow Hunter Vol'tris is a jungle troll located in Torga's Rest in Nazmir during Faction Assaults. He is accompanied by two Darkspear Shadow Hunters.
Shadow-Borne Warriors are troll spectres located in the Lustrous Apse in Kings' Rest.
Shadow-Borne Champions are troll spectres located in the Lustrous Apse in Kings' Rest.
Shadow-Borne Witch Doctors are troll liches located in the Lustrous Apse in Kings' Rest.
Shadow Wind Leggings drop from Syrawon the Dominus in Zuldazar.
Shadow Well is located in the Netherlight Temple upon researching Altars of Blessing.
Shadowbound Orders would drop from the following mobs in Talador: *Felguard Protector *Shadow Pillager *Shadow Looter *Unblinking Watcher
__NOTOC__ Shadowbinder Athissa is a naga located at Zin-Azshari in Nazjatar.
Shadow Lillies are flowers located in the Verdant Mire in . Interacting with them grants water walking for ten minutes.
__NOTOC__ Shadow Hunter Scouts are jungle trolls located in Tiragarde Sound, Drustvar, and Stormsong Valley during Faction Assaults.
__NOTOC__ Shadowbourne Felcasters are orcs located in Talador.
Shado-Pan Wallwatchers are pandaren located along the Serpent's Spine in Pandaria.
Shadow-Weaver Essences are copies of Grand Shadow-Weavers in the Seat of the Triumvirate.
Shadow Stalkers are panthara found in Eredath and the Seat of the Triumvirate. Some are summoned by Shadowguard Riftstalkers.
Shadow-Walker Yash'gth is a n'raqi located in the Vale of Eternal Twilight.
The Shadow Gate is a portal in the Frostfire Ridge. It is used by Borgal Doomfist to get to the Shadowlands.
Shadow-Lined Chalice is looted from the following chests in Revendreth: *Lost Vault *Secret Treasure *Stashed Equipment *Parish Chest
Shadow's Bite is pick pocketed from humanoids in Revendreth.
Shadow of Elune is an Azerite trait available to all classes. It can only be found on Alliance Azerite Armor from Darkshore and the Battle for Darkshore.
Shado-Pan Warriors are pandaren located in Kun-Lai Summit. They later appeared on the Isle of Thunder.
__NOTOC__ Shadowblade Razi is a Zandalari troll located in Atal'Dazar.
The Shadow-Gorged Bracers are created with Tormented Bracers.
The Shadow-Gorged Gauntlets are created with Tormented Gauntlets.
The Shadow-Gorged Legguards are created with Tormented Leggings.
The Shadow-Gorged Spaulders are created with Tormented Spaulders.
Shadow Infusers are fel orcs located in the Pits of Mannoroth in .

Shadow Slicing Shortsword starts from the Shadow Slicing Shortsword (item) on an altar floating out in the void after using the Phasing Korthian Shrine at atop Hope's Ascent. Get to the altar, pick up the quest, then get back to safety within sixty seconds or run the risk of getting dropped into the void.
__NOTOC__ Shadow of Zul is a projection of Prophet Zul located in Kings' Rest.
Shadow-Scarred Headcover drops from Kil'jaeden in the Tomb of Sargeras.
Shadow-Weaver's Crown drops from Saprish in the Seat of the Triumvirate.
Shadow-Singed Fang drops from the Felhounds of Sargeras in Antorus, the Burning Throne.
The Shadow-Wreathed Vambraces drop from Zul'gath the Flayer in The Maw.

Shadowfang Keep is a haunted keep in southern Silverpine Forest, near Pyrewood Village. It is the base of operations for the evil archmage Arugal and his worgen progeny.

Shadowglen (or Shadow Glen) is the night elven starting area. It is found in the northeastern part of Teldrassil, which is just north of Starbreeze Village. Like all starting areas, it has class trainers for all night elven classes. After the Burning of Teldrassil, Shadowglen Keepers fought against the Horde at Lor'danel in Darkshore.
